q.t: 24 teachers from one school and 28 from another go on a trip. How many teachers in all?
q.e: 4 + 8 = 12 Ones = 1 Ten 2 Ones; regroup the Ten: 2 + 2 + 1 = 5 Tens. So 52.

q.t: Find 83 − 46.
q.e: 3 Ones is not enough to take 6, so break 1 Ten into 10 Ones: 13 − 6 = 7, then 7 − 4 = 3 Tens.

q.t: An item costs ₹113. You pay ₹150. What balance do you get back (in ₹)?
q.e: Balance = paid − cost: count up from 113 to 120 (7) and on to 150 (30): 37.

q.t: Find 38 + 16.
Daisy and Lou had ₹185 and got ₹125 more. How much do they have now (in ₹)?
q.e: 5 + 5 = 10 Ones → 1 Ten; 8 + 2 + 1 = 11 Tens → 1 Hundred 1 Ten; 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 Hundreds.
Regroup a Hundred into Tens and a Ten into Ones, then take away: 10 − 9 = 1, 10 − 7 = 3, 2 − 1 = 1.

q.t: 10 Ones can be regrouped as:
q.e: Ten single ones bundled together make one Ten.

q.t: Onions cost ₹32 for 1 kg. How much do 2 kg cost (in ₹)?
q.e: 2 kg costs the price of 1 kg twice: 32 + 32.

q.t: Cost ₹185, paid ₹200. What is the balance (in ₹)?
q.e: Count up from 185 to 200: 5 to reach 190 and 10 more to reach 200.

Preeti’s school has 423 children. It has 178 fewer than her cousin’s school. How many children are in the cousin’s school?
q.e: The cousin’s school is the bigger one, so add the 178 back: 423 + 178.

q.e: Adding 99 is adding 100 and taking back 1: 911 − 1 = 910.

Estimate 438 + 476 by rounding each to the nearest hundred.
q.e: 438 is about 400 and 476 is about 500; 400 + 500 = 900 (the exact answer, 914, is close).

q.t: Ram Chacha got 264 mangoes last year and 527 this year. How many more did he get this year?
q.e: ‘How many more’ compares two amounts, so subtract: 527 − 264.

q.t: Ranganna made 639 dolls and sold 531. How many dolls are left?
Rami read a book of 236 pages. Kesu read three books of 96, 30 and 90 pages. Who read more, and by how many pages?
q.e: Kesu read 96 + 30 + 90 = 216 pages; 236 − 216 = 20, so Rami read 20 more.

You paid ₹200 and got ₹75 back. What did the item cost (in ₹)?
q.e: Cost + balance = amount paid, so cost = 200 − 75.

q.t: An item cost ₹580 and the balance returned was ₹120. How much was paid (in ₹)?
q.e: The money paid covers the cost and the balance: 580 + 120.

q.t: A bus leaves with 46 people. At the first stop 18 get off and 25 get on. At the second stop 30 get off. How many are on the bus now?
Books have 145, 210, 64 and 88 pages. Asha has finished the 145-page and 64-page books and 30 pages of the 210-page book. How many pages are left to read?
q.e: All books have 507 pages; she has read 145 + 64 + 30 = 239; 507 − 239 = 268.

q.e: The thickest has 236 pages and the thinnest 30, and 236 − 30 = 206.
